Image: native_job.py:24–25 is `nationalinstruments/labview:2026q1-linux@sha256:597ba99260c0511475e27c04f13dd06f2f57e8ce7d3ee6c1ca289020b1f8c426`, exactly labview-runtime.json:2. native_job.py:171–172 rejects a differing configured image or LabVIEW path.
